scoring_justification: DFT results submitted as final JSON; raw charge density or band energies not available for recompute. T0 comparison to paper gold with structural ordering checks is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold ground-state labels, band gap values, energy ordering, moment ranges for ZO(3,6) and ZA(3,8).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text: ZO(3,6) AFM-G, gap 155.2 meV, O moments 0.11-0.31 μB; ZA(3,8) FM metal, total moment ~2 μB.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper and embedded in verifier prepare context.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s reported results; the reference solve writes these exact numbers.

outputs.description: Scored results for O-terminated ZO(3,6). Contains the identified magnetic ground state, total energies relative to NM, the band gap, and the range of oxygen local magnetic moments.
Scored results for O-terminated ZA(3,8). Contains the identified magnetic ground state, total energies relative to NM, band gap (0 denotes metallic), and total magnetization per unit cell.

output_contract.notes: No gold values or tolerances are revealed. The checker verifies the ground-state string, energy ordering, band-gap magnitude, and magnetic moment range against paper-reported references.
